correctness.rationale: The component GDA matrices are exactly \(M\) and \(M^\top\) because their common curvature is symmetric and the opposing coupling is skew-symmetric. For any real M and any independent initialization with second moment \(I\), enumerating the four IID index pairs and two reshuffling permutations gives difference \(\frac12(\|MM^\top\|_F^2-\|M^2\|_F^2)\). Trace cyclicity proves this equals \(\frac14\|MM^\top-M^\top M\|_F^2\). The block commutator is \([H,K]=\begin{psmallmatrix}0&AC-CB\\(AC-CB)^\top&0\end{psmallmatrix}\), so the difference is exactly \(2h^4\|AC-CB\|_F^2\). Direct expansion proves the planar direction cone. The rational witness has a positive definite contraction certificate with minors \(19/32\) and \(33/256\); directions give \(-5/1024\) and \(+7/1024\), summing to \(+1/512\). Standalone standard-library verifier checked 1011 rational assertions, and the analytic proof, not finite tests, establishes all dimensions and parameters. No independent audit was performed.
residual_risks: No independent mathematical referee has reconstructed the proof.
The executable tests sample finite matrices; the trace proof is the basis for infinite quantifiers.

originality.rationale: The direct 2022 strongly convex-concave RR literature supplies epoch-level convergence bounds, rather than an identity equating a same-step two-call isotropic reversal to the squared curvature-coupling defect. PSD noncommutative product comparisons require symmetric semidefinite step factors and cannot imply the reversal for the nonsymmetric GDA factors here. General shuffled scalar-objective SGD analysis uses a gradient-field setting distinct from primal-dual game dynamics. The exact general adjoint-product identity may be classical; the asserted contribution is its complete, sharp finite-epoch game consequence and deterministic cone, not an independent discovery of all such trace identities.
residual_risks: The elementary adjoint-product trace identity may appear in earlier numerical linear algebra or nonnormal matrix literature under different terminology.
No claim of globally exhaustive literature or database coverage; specialized finite-epoch SGDA comparisons may be undiscovered.
The general convergence-rate literature concerns different time, tuning, or assumptions, so the result must not be portrayed as contradicting those theorems.

value.rationale: The exact all-dimensional equality and iff criterion \(AC=CB\) make coupling–curvature imbalance a structural diagnostic for when a full reshuffled pass is worse in averaged squared saddle distance. The obstruction persists for arbitrarily small contractive steps, so it is not a trivial divergence counterexample. The complete planar start-direction cone shows why isotropic averages conceal locally beneficial reshuffling and gives a quantitative finite-evaluation sampling tradeoff. This is a motivated mathematical boundary within finite-sum saddle optimization rather than an arbitrary matrix slice or a generic AMGM restatement.
residual_risks: It is a two-evaluation, two-component benchmark, not a guarantee for many-epoch practical optimization or dynamically selected learning rates.
